inlines.v: SIDERA'TION, noun [Latin sideratio; sidero, to blast, from sidus, a star.] 1. A blasting or blast in plants; a sudden deprivation of sense; an apoplexy; a slight erysipelas. 2. A sphacelus, or a species of erysipelas, vulgarly called a blast.
